description: Add minimal observability to the sandbox agents using LiteLLM's native callback mechanism. Maximum visibility with minimum code changes: callback registration for automatic LLM call tracing (tokens, cost, latency), optional @observe() decorator or metadata-based trace grouping per task, environment-variable-only activation, and an optional dependency group. No custom ObservabilityContext classes, no new packages, no deep span hierarchy. Includes deep research on 10+ observability tools.
